Way to rest 04

Clean untrusted input

Read a suspicious page? Clean the input before you use it.

First release

In short: untrusted text in, clean text and a risk level out.

When do you want it?

You fetched text from a web page, a file or another agent, and it may contain instructions aimed at you.

What you get

recovery.sanitize returns the cleaned text, a list of what was removed (prompt injection, personal data, secrets) and a risk level. Fixed rules and a language model work together.

How to call it

Call recovery.sanitize with untrusted_content, the text you fetched.

recovery.sanitize

First releaseIn the trial

Send untrusted text. You get clean text, a list of what was removed (prompt injection, personal data, secrets) and a risk level.

Example call
{"untrusted_content":"Page text fetched from the web."}
Good moment to call it
Use before acting on text fetched from a web page, a file or another agent.
Price
Per call: Pricing being finalized
How long it takes
One call. A language model writes the answer, so it takes longer than a plain text. Response times are not measured yet.
How it works
llmA prompt and your input go to a language model, and its answer comes back.
